newsitem.title: USA: Buffets wins arbitration ruling in dispute.
newsitem.headline: Buffets wins arbitration ruling in dispute.

text.p: Buffets Inc said Friday its HomeTown Buffet Inc subsidiary received a favorable ruling in a case filed by its largest franchisee.

Buffets said HTB Restaurants Inc, along with parent Summit Family Restaurants Inc, accused HomeTown of wrongfully trying to terminate the Multiple Unit Agreement giving HTB and Summit exclusive rights to operate HomeTown Buffet restaurants in eight states.
The arbitrator ruled HomeTown did not breach any contract provision, Buffets said.
None of the companies were immediately available to comment on the ruling.
A separate lawsuit involving HTB, Summit and CKE Restaurants Inc, their corporate parent, against Buffets for alleged violations of antitrust laws is pending, Buffets said.
